background: Northern Trust Corporation is the holding company of a Chicago-based custodian and wealth manager, earning fees from asset servicing for institutions and from managing money for wealthy families and foundations.
synthesis: Fitch rates the group AA-, S&P A+ and Moody's A2, all stable. Capital is mixed against US banks, with CET1 of 12.0% just below the peer median but leverage of 8.5% in the top quarter; since 31 Mar 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.9 points and leverage 0.6 points. Liquidity is the weak spot, with LCR of 107% in the bottom quarter. The flagged news is good, with second-quarter earnings above estimates on 22 Jul 2026.
